trust_decision.summary: Download::downloadFile releases a purchased file when the URL hash equals md5 of the order timestamp (derivable from order date, order ID is sequential), so the 'secret' is predictable; the same md5(date) is produced in buildDownloadURL.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'predictable digital download token'; the /store_download route maps directly to downloadFile whose check is md5(orderDate).

fix_sites.entry_point: Download::buildDownloadURL, called from checkout complete page (single_pages/checkout/complete.php:42) and order receipt email (mail/order_receipt.php:69)
Doctrine ORM entity schema (new oSecurityCode column, fix.diff:44-45) with getter/setter (fix.diff:54-62)
Order::add, reached from checkout submit / payment completion

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/CommunityStore/Order/Order.php:572-667 (Order::add, where the fix generates the random code) plus the ORM column near src/CommunityStore/Order/Order.php:147; the check in Download.php never calls Order::add and must read a persisted value

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can 'fix' the verifier alone (e.g. HMAC of order ID+date with a site secret, computed in Download.php on both build and check) and argue no schema/model change is needed; equally, they may keep md5(date) fallback for legacy orders as 'backwards compatibility' (the published fix itself does this, fix.diff:117-121).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Links already emailed/displayed for orders placed before the change (md5(date) hash, within download_expiry_hours) and the expiry threshold must keep working; the link must still be buildable from the receipt email template and complete page.

O6_input_shapes: new order with stored random security code
legacy order without stored code (md5(date) fallback)

O7_producer.where: src/CommunityStore/Order/Order.php:621-667 (Order::add populates the entity; fix inserts code generation at fix.diff:71-72) persisted through Doctrine column (fix.diff:44-45)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Temporary order records created before payment get oDate but no token; if order finalised via the temp-order path the add() reuse sets the code, but the published fix keeps md5(date) acceptance for any order lacking a code
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Temp orders are not paid orders and legacy fallback is needed for old links

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Non-constant-time / loose '==' comparison of the hash (PHP numeric-string juggling); a how-type sibling where fix needs hash_equals and strict typing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Existing code already uses loose == on the token, and the published fix keeps it (fix.diff:114)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A planted 'resend download links' or admin/customer order-view action that rebuilds the URL with its own md5(date) instead of buildDownloadURL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Templates already build download links in two places (mail and complete page); a third copy in another controller is a plausible maintainer shortcut

O10_build.toolchain: Composer + Concrete CMS 8.5/9 host install (package, not standalone), Node/yarn for assets
services: PHP web server with Concrete CMS
O10_build.project_tests: none found (no tests/ or phpunit config in pinned tree)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace md5(date) with md5/sha of date+orderID or an HMAC in Download.php only, or drop the legacy md5 fallback breaking already-issued links.
